changes: You can now enter the cash you start the day with from the Sales page.
Simple POS now shows your cash sales separately from your total sales.
You can see the expected cash in the drawer based on your starting cash plus orders paid in cash.
Starting cash is saved separately for each day, so you can also review it when looking back at previous sales days.
Starting cash, cash sales and expected cash are now included in the sales CSV summary.
If your menu is empty, you can now add your first product straight from the product grid.
Tapping 'Add your first product' takes you directly to the product setup screen.
You can now look back at sales from previous days using the calendar in Sales.
You can export a sales CSV for any saved day, even if you forgot to do it at the end of the day.
When placing an order, you can now choose how the customer paid: Cash, Card, Bank Transfer or QR Payment.
Payment methods are now shown with orders and included in sales exports.
New users now see a short welcome that explains how Simple POS works and where their data is saved.
Simple POS can now show a What's New message when new features are added.
The How to Use guide has been rewritten to make setup and everyday use easier to follow.
Choose from ready-made themes and switch between Light, Dark or System mode.
Add your own logo and brand colors to make Simple POS match your business.
Give individual products their own highlight color and short labels such as Today's Special or New.
Change the order of your product categories.
Add many products at once by importing a CSV file.
Add a payment QR code and bank transfer details for customers.
Save your Simple POS setup to a file and move it to another device or browser.
Use the built-in How to Use guide for help with setup and day-to-day use.
